threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for a bus at the stop instead of just walking straight to the nearest railway station. That’s a dead giveaway.
Caught a bloke on the 59 last night arguing with a pigeon like it owed him money. The bird just stared him down, unfazed. Classic Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a group at the corner arguing passionately about which Späti has the best döner. It was like a local culture shock.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, it’s not just about street art; it's the spontaneous techno parties in abandoned buildings that keep popping up. You never know when or where!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they complain about the BART delays like it’s a rite of passage, not just a nuisance. It’s practically our weather report.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy trying to board the 38 with a full-sized inflatable unicorn. Muni drivers didn’t even blink. Just another day in the Tenderloin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just grab a 'café amb llet' when in fact, locals often want it with a slice of pa amb tomàquet on the side.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newcomer by their wide-eyed amazement at the street performers in Plaça del Sol—locals barely glance their way anymore.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look for a parking spot instead of embracing the chaos of the double yellow lines. It’s like a rite of passage around here.
Last night on the 35, a guy tried to sell a live goldfish in a plastic bag. The driver just shook his head and kept driving.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a guy in a suit stop to help a kid fix his bike by the canal, just like it was the most normal thing in the world.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a spontaneous, midnight BBQ on the East Side Gallery with strangers turned friends, music blaring till sunrise.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they can list at least three taco trucks without consulting Yelp. Tourist order 'that one with the long line.'

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy juggle on the 31 while the bus hit every pothole. He didn’t break a sweat—just another day on Muni with a front-row view of chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just grab a churro and go. Locals know it’s all about the tranquil moments at the plaça, savoring every bite.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by their reluctance to dodge the pigeons in Plaça del Sol. The locals glide through like it’s an Olympic sport.
